| description = Directions to Jelek Icepaw:

Head out of the first room after dropping down into the pits. The 2nd room has 2 exits, straight and to the right. Take the right path, this 3rd room is a 'safe room', and a good spot to set up camp. Move on through the 4th and 5th rooms until you get to the next junction, at the 6th room. If you look to your left from here, you'll see a room down the ramp that spawns 5 dogs, the center spawn here is Khelkar Icepaw's spot (lute of the howler). Keep going up the ramp from the 6th room to a 4-way junction. To the left from here is a 3 spawn room, and that center spawn is Jelek's spot. 

Taken from http://paladinsofnorrath.yuku.com/topic/1806/Where-does-the-Sword-of-Blessing-Drop-in-Velketors-Lab

He spawns in the room with 4 dogs which is in line with the ramp that goes up to Broodmother area. He doesn't rampage or enrage. Quite a bit easier than a cliff golem to kill. He is a Paladin so he may heal himself and cast dispels. Unstunnable. Max hit was 220. If he has the Sword of Blessings, it will say, "Jelek slashes," while he is attacking.
